items.title: How consent travels with an ad request
steps: The consent banner asks for choices
The choices are added to ad requests
Partners check them before using data
Ads show only as the choices allow
items.why: The choice is made once, stored, then passed along with every request.

items.title: How a data access request is handled
steps: A person asks to see their data
The company confirms who they are
It finds the data across its systems
It replies within the legal time
items.why: Check identity, find the data, reply on time and keep a record.
